jobs.title: Product Manager – Public Safety & Justice
jobs.location: USA - Atlanta, GA; USA - Sandy, UT
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Product Manager – Public Safety & Justice

The Role

We’re looking for a technology-focused Product Manager to bring new enterprise software products to market within NiCE Public Safety & Justice.

You’ll work with customers, engineering, and business stakeholders to identify customer needs, shape product requirements, and lead products from discovery through development, launch, and ongoing improvement.

What You’ll Do

- Own product launches: Take new software products from concept and MVP through external launch and beyond.

- Understand customers: Lead discovery to identify customer problems, needs, and market opportunities.

- Define product direction: Translate customer insights into requirements, roadmaps, and priorities.

- Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, design, sales, and product leadership to deliver successful products.

- Support go-to-market: Partner with sales and other teams on product positioning, demos, and launch readiness.

- Improve products: Use customer feedback and market insights to guide future development.

What You’ll Bring

- 3+ years of Product Management experience in B2B software, enterprise technology, or a related field.

- Proven experience taking a new software product or major product offering from discovery through launch to external customers .

- Experience owning products after launch and driving improvements.

- Strong customer discovery, prioritization, and product requirements skills.

- Technical fluency and the ability to work effectively with engineering teams.

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

- Willingness to travel to customer sites, partners, and industry events as needed.

Nice to Have

- Experience in Public Safety & Justice, 911/emergency communications, CAD/RMS, law enforcement, or digital evidence.

- Familiarity with regulated environments or enterprise technology integrations.

- Experience with technology partnerships or AI-enabled products.

Public Safety & Justice experience is a plus, not a requirement. We’re open to candidates from other enterprise technology backgrounds who have the right product ownership and launch experience.

How We Work

You’ll join a collaborative team that values customer-focused thinking, clear communication, and moving quickly from ideas to execution.

Atlanta-based team members work in the office two days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the US may work remotely and travel to Atlanta regularly.

About NiCE Public Safety & Justice

NiCE Public Safety & Justice provides software that supports emergency response and criminal justice—from the 911 call to the courtroom.

NiCE is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds.
About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.location: USA - Atlanta, GA; USA - Sandy, UT
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Product Owner – Automated Insights Innovation

Primary Purpose

As a Product Owner, you will support the ongoing development and enhancement of the Automated Insights prototype application across its lifecycle. You will help identify and build use cases that turn insights into measurable operational improvements, creating capabilities for customer demonstrations and future integration into NiCE production products.

This is a hands-on product role . You will define and maintain a focused roadmap under the direction of product leadership while also building the application. This includes front-end development, API and connector integrations, maintaining and refactoring existing and AI-generated code, and connecting analytics outputs to application workflows.

You will also serve as a central resource as prototype capabilities move toward production, partnering with Research, Product, Services, Design, Engineering, and other teams to ensure successful transition and avoid rediscovery. Customer and field feedback will help inform roadmap and prioritization decisions.

The ideal candidate combines product judgment with hands-on technical skills. They are comfortable with ambiguity, energized by AI-assisted development, able to prioritize with incomplete information, and comfortable working across technical and business teams.

Primary Functions/Responsibilities

-
Own the Automated Insights prototype across definition, planning, release, enhancements, and maintenance.

-
Define and maintain a focused roadmap and prioritize functionality under product leadership.

-
Build new features and application modules from prototypes and specifications.

-
Maintain, refactor, and improve existing and AI-generated code.

-
Build data visualizations and dashboard-style interfaces from designs.

-
Develop and manage API, webhook, and connector integrations.

-
Connect Python-based analytics outputs to application workflows.

-
Support prototype capabilities as they transition into production, partnering with cross-functional teams.

-
Document functionality, dependencies, limitations, and technical considerations for receiving teams.

-
Support customer-facing demonstrations, troubleshooting, and rapid issue resolution.

-
Capture feedback from customers, field teams, and product teams to inform prioritization.

-
Support application scalability, performance, reliability, version control, and CI/CD practices.

-
Support other innovation projects, prototypes, solutions, and deployments as needed.

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Intelligence/Analytics, or a related field.

Equivalent practical experience in a hands-on product or software development role may be considered in place of a degree.

Required Experience/Skills

-
3+ years of combined experience in product ownership, product management, or hands-on application development, including ownership through multiple release cycles.

-
Experience defining and prioritizing a roadmap and making trade-off decisions with incomplete information.

-
Hands-on experience with GenAI coding tools such as Claude Code or similar.

-
Proficiency in JavaScript and modern front-end frameworks, preferably React, including HTML and CSS.

-
Experience building data visualizations or dashboard-style interfaces.

-
Experience with REST APIs, authentication, webhooks, and connector integrations.

-
Working knowledge of Python sufficient to read analytics code and interpret data science outputs.

-
Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD practices.

-
Ability to take ownership of and improve code they did not originally write.

-
Familiarity with rapid prototyping tools and practices.

-
Experience partnering cross-functionally to move concepts into production.

-
Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.

-
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to a changing environment.

Preferred Experience

-
Experience moving prototypes or proof-of-concepts into production.

-
Experience with Customer Experience, Contact Center, CCaaS, WEM, or enterprise SaaS platforms.

-
Exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, or outbound engagement platforms such as Cognigy, Verse, or similar.

-
Experience supporting customer demonstrations, pilots, or proof-of-concept work.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may perform other reasonable related duties as assigned. NiCE reserves the right to revise or change job duties as business needs arise.

Note: Local residents preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Actimize
jobs.location: USA - Atlanta, GA; USA - Hoboken, NJ; USA - Sandy, UT
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Senior Product Manager, KYC Data Intelligence

NICE Actimize is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own strategy and execution for a portfolio of data intelligence products supporting Know Your Customer (KYC) and financial crime risk management. You will identify high-value customer problems, define product strategy and roadmaps, partner with engineering and data teams from discovery through launch, and drive adoption with sales, marketing, services, partners, and customers. The portfolio may include watchlist, adverse media, entity-risk analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities used in customer screening and KYC due-diligence workflows. This role is ideal for an experienced enterprise software product leader who combines customer insight, technical fluency, commercial judgment, and disciplined execution.

How You Will Make an Impact

- Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities for assigned KYC data intelligence products and capabilities.

- Lead customer and market discovery to identify unmet needs, validate opportunities, and translate insights into scalable product investments.

- Define target users, use cases, product requirements, release priorities, and acceptance criteria in partnership with technical product management, engineering, data, and analytics teams.

- Guide products through the full lifecycle—from discovery and business case through development, launch, adoption, growth, and ongoing optimization.

- Define and track success measures for customer value, adoption, usage, data quality, product performance, commercial outcomes, and roadmap execution.

- Partner with sales, marketing, services, and enablement teams to develop positioning, packaging, launch plans, sales tools, and customer-facing narratives.

- Serve as a trusted product expert with customers, prospects, partners, and internal stakeholders; clearly communicate strategy, roadmap decisions, and product value.

- Support strategic customer engagements and resolve escalated product issues by balancing immediate needs with the integrity and scalability of the broader product.

- Monitor the competitive, regulatory, technology, and data-provider landscape across KYC, financial crime analytics, identity, and AI.

Required Qualifications

- Five or more years of software product management experience, including ownership of complex products for financial services.

- Demonstrated experience managing products across the full lifecycle, including discovery, validation, prioritization, delivery, launch, adoption, and optimization.

- Experience with enterprise SaaS, APIs, data platforms, analytics, workflow products, or other cloud-based software.

- Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to translate complex market needs into a clear product strategy and scalable requirements.

- Proven ability to prioritize roadmaps, make informed trade-offs, and align technical and commercial stakeholders around decisions.

- Technical fluency is sufficient to collaborate effectively with engineering, architecture, data, analytics, and operations teams.

- Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.

- Ability to operate with autonomy, bring structure to ambiguous problems, influence without direct authority, and drive decisions through execution.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with KYC, AML, customer screening, financial crime, or regulatory technology and data solutions.

- Knowledge of watchlists, adverse media, entity risk, identity data, risk-data licensing.

- Experience with global regulated financial institutions and mission-critical enterprise systems.

- Experience managing AI, generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics products.

- Familiarity with cloud architecture, REST APIs, data ingestion, enterprise integrations, security, privacy, or regulatory requirements.

- Experience with product pricing, packaging, partnerships, or commercial business cases.

What’s in It for You?

You will have meaningful ownership of products that help financial institutions identify and manage financial crime risk. You will work with experienced product, engineering, data, commercial, and delivery teams in a global market with complex customer problems and significant opportunities for innovation. NICE offers a collaborative environment, broad exposure to customers and senior leaders, and career opportunities across roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are motivated by customer impact, technical problem-solving, and building products that scale, you may be our next NICEr.

Enjoy NICE-FLEX

At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which provides flexibility through two days in the office and three days of remote work each week. Office days focus on face-to-face collaboration, teamwork, and the exchange of new ideas.

About NICE Actimize

NICE Actimize is a leading provider of financial crime, risk, and compliance solutions for regional and global financial institutions and government regulators. Our experts apply innovative technology to help institutions identify financial crime, prevent fraud, support regulatory compliance, and safeguard consumers’ and investors’ assets.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

NiCE is looking for a Senior Product Manager – AI to lead the definition and hands‑on creation of AI‑native, market‑leading Customer Experience solutions.

In this role, you will own innovative AI capabilities across the NiCE CX platform, shaping how AI understands customer interactions, guides human agents, and automates outcomes at enterprise scale. You will have the opportunity to personally design, prototype, and validate AI‑driven product experiences.

You will be responsible for building the next generation of AI‑powered CX solutions—not just features, but intelligent systems and working prototypes—while maintaining NiCE’s standards for security, governance, and enterprise readiness.

This is a highly hands‑on product role, ideal for a PM who enjoys building, experimenting, and turning ideas into tangible product artifacts quickly.

How will you make an impact?

- Identifying real market and customer problems through research, data analysis, and direct customer engagement—and rapidly turning insights into working product prototypes

- Driving AI‑first product strategy, ensuring that AI is designed as a foundation for outcomes, not just an add‑on feature

- Using prototypes as a core decision‑making tool—to explore solutions, de‑risk complexity, and accelerate time‑to‑value

- Delivering clear, actionable roadmaps and strategic plans that are grounded in validated product concepts, not assumptions

- Championing customer experience excellence through experimentation, iteration, and feedback‑driven improvements

- Collaborating in a truly cross‑functional environment, where product, engineering, and data teams work as one

- Leading data‑driven decision making, using analytics, experimentation, and model performance insights to guide priorities and trade‑offs

- Helping NiCE stay ahead of the market by bringing innovation, speed, and hands‑on AI fluency into everything we build

If you’re excited about building AI products—not just defining them, and want to shape the future of CX with real impact, this is the role for you.

Have you got what it takes?

- 5+ years of software product management experience, delivering enterprise‑grade cloud and/or on‑prem solutions

- Proven hands‑on experience working on AI‑powered, data‑driven, or automation‑centric products

- Strong technical understanding, with the ability to personally prototype solutions and work deeply with engineering and data science teams

- Experience influencing decisions across multiple global stakeholders and functions

- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a bias toward outcomes and execution

- Experience translating concepts and ideas into concrete product artifacts (prototypes, flows, experiments, validation plans)

- Excellent communication skills—able to engage effectively from executive leadership to individual contributors

- Ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel and thrive in a fast‑paced environment

- Comfortable working directly with customers and partners, including in high‑pressure situations

- Willingness to travel globally

- Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, or similar)

You will have an advantage if you also have:

- Hands‑on experience using GenAI tools for prototyping, discovery, experimentation, or productivity

- Experience in Customer Experience, Contact Center, CCaaS, WEM, or enterprise SaaS platforms

- Knowledge of AI/ML concepts, including model behavior, evaluation, and lifecycle considerations

- Experience with cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

- Familiarity with IP telephony, recording, compliance, or regulated enterprise environments

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager within NiCE’s Agentic AI line of business, you will take ownership of shaping how our products are positioned, communicated, and brought to market. You will work closely with Product and Marketing teams to define compelling narratives, drive go to market strategies, and ensure consistent, high impact messaging across all channels.

This role operates at the intersection of strategy and execution, requiring strong collaboration across multiple product teams and adjacent functions. You will play a key role in aligning stakeholders, influencing roadmap discussions, and strengthening Product Marketing’s strategic voice within the organization.

You have an AI first mindset that thrives on solving challenges in new, creative ways. It is critical to apply this skill to storytelling that can distill sophisticated technology in new solutions and/or features into a clear and simple value proposition and to optimize workflows to maximize quality and efficiency.

Success in this role means delivering clear, differentiated messaging, enabling revenue teams, and driving measurable market impact in a fast-evolving AI landscape.

How will you make an impact

- Define and execute marketing plans including positioning, messaging, launches, and asset strategy

- Partner closely with Product teams to ensure early and continuous alignment on roadmap, value propositions, and go to market strategy

- Drive cross functional initiatives with Analyst Relations, Competitive Intelligence, PR, Sales Enablement, and Evangelism to ensure consistent narratives and coordinated market impact

- Develop clear, compelling messaging frameworks that differentiate products and resonate with target audiences

- Create and elevate high quality assets including presentations, thought leadership, launch materials, sales enablement content, one pagers, and website copy

- Apply an AI first approach to product storytelling and internal workflows to improve efficiency and output quality

- Strengthen Product Marketing’s role as a strategic partner by influencing decisions and aligning diverse stakeholder priorities

- Continuously evolve Product Marketing processes, tools, and ways of working to operate effectively in a complex environment

- Balance strategic thinking with hands on execution to deliver high quality outputs that drive business results

Have you got what it takes?

- 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, preferably within the contact center, SaaS or AI environments
• Proven ability to own product marketing initiatives end to end, from strategy through execution
• Strong technical understanding of SaaS and AI products and the ability to translate capabilities into customer value
• Hands on experience using advanced AI tools and automation to improve marketing workflows and asset quality
• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to align cross functional teams in complex environments
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

- Ability to operate effectively in a fast paced, high growth environment with multiple priorities
• Comfortable representing the company internally and externally, including presenting in webinars, events, and analyst engagements

What’s in it for you?

Join an innovative, fast growing organization at the forefront of AI, where you will have the opportunity to shape how cutting edge products are brought to market. You will work alongside high performing teams in a collaborative and dynamic environment, with strong opportunities for growth and impact.

If you are passionate about product marketing, AI innovation, and driving meaningful business outcomes, this could be your next big opportunity at NiCE.
